items.label: 【Note】
items.value: 1. This set only includes the cover, not the cushion. 2. Please check your sofa size and our cushion cover replacement set size before ordering to make sure they will fit your patio cushions. (Exact measurements to within ±1 inch are appropriate.)

items.label: 【Package Included】
items.value: These outdoor patio cushion covers include 14 pieces in total. 6 seat cushion cover (25.6Lx25.6Wx4H inches), 6 backrest cushion cover (25.6Lx15Wx4H inches) and 2 small back cushion cover (21.6Lx15Wx4H inches). Outdoor cushion covers suitable for various 6-seater outdoor modular sofa cushions.

items: 【Fabric Features】 Outdoor patio cushion covers are made of professional yarn-dyed polyester fabric, specially made for outdoor cushion covers. The outdoor cushion cover fabric is anti-fading and anti-splash, and the fabric is colorful, soft, comfortable and durable. Outdoor patio cushion covers provide superior protection for your sofa and make your furniture look like new again!

【Easy to Replace and Clean】Regular cleaning of outdoor cushion covers for patio furniture can effectively protect the cushions and your health. The outdoor furniture cushion covers are zippered so they can be easily changed. Minor stains can be easily wiped clean with a damp cloth. Outdoor patio cushion covers can be either hand or machine washed, however, bleach should not be used and ironing should be avoided.

items.label: 【Professional Manufacturing】
items.value: This outdoor cushion cover has a stylish and neat appearance. Peripheral convex strip design, not easy to deform. The back of the 6-seat cushion cover has an anti-slip design. Due to different monitors, the color of the picture and actual cushion cover will be slightly different. If you encounter any product issues, damage and missing parts, please contact us for replacement.
